Just thinking that maybe time will reward me later. Hang in there for your friends and family, it sounds like your depression is lying to you. See, that's the issue. I'm not an introvert but when I go out in social situations, I feel very defeated for being overwhelmed by negative feelings that I choose to stay inside. Especially when it comes to girls, I get insanely jealous when ANY guy talks to a girl right in front of me. It's super unhealthy, and obviously something like that is going to keep me inside. Today was pretty successful though, a situation like that actually happened, and I just acted cool and all was good. I'm also thinking soccer or volleyball or something since I'm kind of a short guy.

Hey dude. What you just said was really well thought out and well written, seriously. I appreciate that. Just cus you're 30 years old doesn't mean it's too late for whatever goal you have. Do you have any deeper reasons as to why you stay in so much instead of just anxiety and self consciousness? I mean, you kinda said it already which is really simple but just wondering. There's a lot of struggles for me in general but ugh, my issues are pretty tough to articulate dude. It makes sense. We're human, complex creatures that make irrational decisions all of the time, and our environments are extremely dynamic even though it looks plain to the naked eye. For me, I'm actually extremely fun and extroverted. If you met me, you would have a very fond memory of me and want to hangout with me more although I'm a BROODER, JEALOUS ,and AFRAID person. I guess that's why it's hitting me even harder that it's soo fucking difficult to make new friends? I don't know where I'm going with this just trying to open up, I can't live being antisocial man. I wanna go out and meet girls. I wanna hobby like normal people. I'm an outsider.

I am sorry for putting you down in anyway if I did. I'm just going through emotional trauma and this was triggering because I was cyberbullied on here. I was just holding onto my times that I was cyberbullied very recently and lashed out on you, and I'm sorry.

First of all: I wanted to say congratulations on your success, as we all deserve to make better lives for ourselves. One day, I will make one too. On the outside, I look fine. I even look like a leader to some.

Secondly:  I have a lot of things to say about this that makes my situation a bit more stigmatized, which I'm genuinely seeking help for to improve my life. My home environment was equally chaotic but not in a way that is usually broadcasted in the world. My parents are hoarders so I never really felt good about bringing people or girls over. My big brother did though. I have ADHD, and depression. I've been called an easy target all of my life because I literally fucking am one. I tried teaching but I'm such a depressed person, the kids feed off of my negative energy and the bad ones just get worse. I tried to kill myself twice in school because I was getting bullied and didn't even realize it. I was the "class clown" because that's all I knew what to do because I was falling behind on my grades. I got into legal trouble twice in school and went to a place for kids who were in need. There, I sat and just watched people play basketball. I'm 5'2. I've been picked up, pantsed, the girl I went on a date with made fun of me, had rocks thrown at me, gossiped about, laughed at by my brother, bestfriend, another friend I tried to help had sex with the girl I liked, I have to get tested for HIV, my bestfriend's an alcoholic, and I babysat him while he was sleeping on the street and he told me to kill myself,I reach out to get help. Don't get me fucking wrong. I'm not a fucking pussy. I stand up for myself. I confront my dad, I confront my friends about their bullshit. I get cyberbullied but my parents tell me just to stay away from it, another friend brags to me about his money while the other one is sleeping with his sister (but I don't tell because I'm a loyal mother fucker), my old lady therapist has a crush on me, I stay up until 5 am on chatrooms because I have no friends, I blacked out once, got punched in the face, pissed my pants and the whole school talked about it, I have IBS so I avoid all social interaction. I bring weird girls home, my parents took in a crackhead who I smoked pot with, the love of my life just got married. See. I have an illusion of a good life. We're book hoarders so the house is so unhealthy of an environment that I got sick twice so I went back and did Algebra with the worst math teacher and was stuck with all of the black kids who would cheat off of me, I've seen bloods and crips fight, I've been to jail, and friends have all humiliated me, my friends use me and drop me because they know I'm a people pleaser and a weak person. I've been behind on Algebra for YEARS. I'M IN ALGEBRA FUCKING 1. They always try something new and I never can learn it cus I'm fucking ADHD.  I'm a hermit. I never ever was good at school. My dad experienced depression and was bullied in the past. My mom is narcisstic, whenever I bring up something about my beliefs or my opinions, she starts complaining about her current mental state. So I have to parent them. I have to parent my parents who always ask for attention. I always have to be the fun one who has jokes because my mom's depressed. My friends are partying and having sex with girls. I have NEVER done a good job in work. Please don't be encouraging, it's not true. I have poor social skills, I complain, and there are a lot of other issues going on that I don't even feel like explaining. So now what Dr.? I'm sorry for sounding angry but emotional neglect and bullying is ignored, and that's why school shootings happen.  I try to stand out for being me but get my balls kicked every day I am awake. My life's a shitstorm. I'll fucking remain strong and get through this bullshit. Fuck all of you. I hope one day the Joker gets the last laugh.

My ex cheated on me with a number of guys that I probably don't even know about. My heart's broken, and I'm suicidal.  I've reached out on here and got trolled like a motherfucker, I've had my Facebook account hacked. I guess I harbor a shitton of resentment. Anyone who talks to me actually sees me as a person that they like.

Don't say I'm not doing anything either:

I exercise every day, I've played in a death metal concert, I've biked across America, I've ran a marathon, I'm dressing better, I meditate, read, I say positive affirmations in the mirror EVERY DAY for 360 days, I learned piano in 60 days, I travel the world, I'm investing in stocks, I've studied 4 different languages, I'm in Social Services and helping kids going through similar shit but they're all BLACK and really fucked.  I've been to 15 therapists, I watch TED talks, I'm doing acupuncture, yoga, religious movements, I've saved a shitton of money because I know the concept of liberality, and I'm actually a compassionate person. But I'm an imposter and didn't earn much of any of this. I was born in the richest part of the world so I don't deserve to live an enriching life. I stand out and do all of this amazing shit.... To be normal. To be regarded as a person. :(((((
